panels.title: 1 · Feedback over time (👍 / 👎 per hour)
panels.description: Raw user feedback volume collected from the Streamlit UI.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time,
       sum(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS "thumbs up",
       sum(CASE WHEN rating = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "thumbs down"
FROM feedback
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 2 · Positive feedback rate
panels.description: Share of thumbs-up among all feedback.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "positive rate"
FROM feedback WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: 3 · Answers & insufficient-data rate
panels.description: Volume plus how often the app correctly refuses for lack of grounding.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "answers",
       round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN insufficient THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "insufficient %",
       round(avg(n_results), 1) AS "avg docs used"
FROM conversations WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: 4 · Latency by stage (p50 / p95, ms)
panels.description: Where wall-clock time goes: rewriting, retrieval, cross-encoder re-ranking, generation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_rewrite_ms)  AS "p50 rewrite",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_retrieve_ms) AS "p50 retrieve",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_rerank_ms)   AS "p50 rerank",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_generate_ms) AS "p50 generate",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)         AS "p95 total"
FROM conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 5 · Token cost per hour and cumulative spend (USD)
panels.description: OpenAI spend derived from logged prompt/completion tokens.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, "hourly cost",
       sum("hourly cost") OVER (ORDER BY time) AS "cumulative cost"
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, sum(cost_usd) AS "hourly cost"
  FROM conversations WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  GROUP BY 1
) t ORDER BY time

panels.title: 6 · Live LLM-judge scores (relevance / groundedness)
panels.description: Distribution of judge scores for answers scored in production (judge toggle in the UI).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(judge_relevance, 0)::text AS score,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE judge_relevance IS NOT NULL)    AS relevance,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE judge_groundedness IS NOT NULL) AS groundedness
FROM conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND judge_relevance IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 7 · Query archetypes and retrieval mode mix
panels.description: What people actually ask, from the rewriter's archetype classification.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT archetype, count(*) AS questions
FROM conversations
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND archetype IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: 8 · Most cited species
panels.description: Which species the assistant actually grounds answers in.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT symbol AS "USDA symbol", count(*) AS citations
FROM conversations, unnest(cited_symbols) AS symbol
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: 9 · Unanswered or downvoted questions
panels.description: The improvement backlog: questions the knowledge base could not ground, plus thumbs-down.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.created_at AS "time", c.question, c.archetype,
       c.insufficient AS "insufficient", f.rating, f.comment
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN feedback f ON f.conversation_id = c.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at) AND (c.insufficient OR f.rating = -1)
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
